pli-tv-bi-vb-pc40:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc40:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo tatth' eva Rājagahe vassaṃ vasanti tattha hemantaṃ tattha gimhaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc40:1.4: āhundarikā bhikkhunīnaṃ disā andhakārā, na imāsaṃ disā pakkhāyantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc40:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc40:1.6: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc40:1.8: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc40:1.9: tena hi bhikkhave bhikkhunīnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpessāmi dasa atthavase paṭicca . . .
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc40:1.12: evañ ca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc40:1.13.1: yā pana bhikkhunī vassaṃ vutthā cārikaṃ na pakkameyya antamaso chappañcayojanāni pi, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc40:2.1.6: purimaṃ vā temāsaṃ pacchimaṃ vā temāsaṃ vutthā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc40:2.1.7: cārikaṃ na pakkamissāmi antamaso chappañcayojanāni pīti dhuraṃ nikkhittamatte āpatti pācittiyassa. ||1||
